description:
Brand Introduction:  
The Authentic Institute of Montessori (AIM) is dedicated to making high-quality Montessori education accessible to educators, parents, and communities around the world. We offer innovative online teacher training and resources that reflect the true essence of Montessori principles, empowering educators to foster a brighter future for children. AIM is a trusted leader in Montessori education, known for upholding the integrity, excellence, and innovation of the Montessori philosophy.

Product Description:  
AIM offers a comprehensive range of Montessori educational resources, including Professional Development Courses, Essentials Courses, Montessori Manuals, Video Lesson Libraries, and Seminar Subscriptions. These products are designed to support educators and parents in implementing authentic Montessori methods in their classrooms and homes. AIM’s offerings cater to various educational levels, ensuring that learners at every stage receive the best possible guidance and support.

USP (Unique Selling Point):  
AIM stands out for its commitment to authenticity in Montessori education. Our programs and resources are crafted by experienced Montessori educators who deeply understand and respect the Montessori philosophy. AIM’s training is not just theoretical; it’s practical, allowing educators to apply Montessori principles effectively. We also emphasize accessibility, making high-quality Montessori education available to a global audience through our online platform.

Payment Terms:  
AIM’s affiliate program offers an attractive 15% commission on all qualifying sales, including Professional Development Courses, Essentials Courses, Montessori Manuals, Video Lesson Libraries, and Seminar Subscriptions. Commissions are paid out monthly, provided the affiliate’s earnings meet the minimum threshold. Payment is processed through the method selected by the affiliate during registration, ensuring a seamless and transparent transaction process.

Other Information:  
AIM affiliates are provided with a comprehensive brand guide, including approved logos and branding assets, to help them promote our products effectively. Affiliates are expected to adhere to these guidelines to ensure consistency in brand representation. Additionally, AIM offers ongoing support and resources to help affiliates succeed, including marketing materials, tracking tools, and dedicated assistance from our team. Joining the AIM Affiliate Program is a way to be part of a global movement that is transforming education through the power of Montessori.
term_and_condition:
These Terms and Conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use products or services from the merchant.

 

By participating in the Program, you agree to use the Program as specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration 

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program registration at our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program registration.

 

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons 

Affiliate links are automatically generated, but you can also create an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later clicks on yours, your link will be the one that counts.

 

Affiliates might be assigned a coupon code, with details and usage clarified in the Dashboard. If a customer clicks on an affiliate link and uses a coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, you’re not allowed to promote any coupon codes.

Affiliates may advertise the merchant’s website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, or offline in classified ads, magazines, and newspapers

3. Commissions and Payment 

When you refer a customer who makes a purchase on our website, you will earn a commission based on the order value, excluding any extra fees (tax, shipping costs, etc.). The commission structure will be outlined in your Dashboard.

 

To receive a commission, you must specify payment details in your Settings. The payment schedule will be detailed on the Affiliate Guide page.

 

Payments will only be issued for transactions that have been successfully completed. The Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy, which allows the merchant to review each referral order. The status of your commissions will be displayed in the Commission tab, and any paid commissions will be listed in the Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing Tools 

We will provide a brand guide, including approved logos and other branding assets, for your marketing use. You are required to adhere strictly to our branding guidelines when creating and sharing graphics or any promotional content. This ensures consistency in our brand representation across all platforms. You may access these materials through the Marketing tool tab, where you can download media or get the HTML embed code for sharing on affiliate channels.

5. Network 

If the Network tab is activated, you can invite others to become your downline affiliates. If any downline affiliate brings an order to the merchant’s shop, the upline affiliate will also earn a network commission, which depends on merchant settings.

 

To invite other affiliates into the system, share your network link. Any affiliate who clicks on that link and signs up will become your downline affiliate.

6. Cookie Tracking 

We use cookies to track individuals who have clicked on your link, so they need to have cookies enabled for us to track them.

If a person does not allow cookies or clears their cookies, we cannot track them, and you will not earn commissions on that person’s activity.

The cookie duration is stated on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking period will start when a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or uses the coupon. Within the cookie period, every order made by that customer on the merchant’s website will automatically result in commissions for the affiliate (there’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link again).

 

7. Removal from the Referral Program 

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: contact@aimmontessori.org.

 

You can always revisit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future, and if you have any questions, please send an email to contact@aimmontessori.org for support.
